title: 第7章 来我卧室
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第二天，时夏禾五点就醒了。

天还没亮。

她拉开窗帘，发现隔壁书房的灯竟然还亮着。

她愣了下。

祁晏辞一夜没睡？

刚这么想着，灯忽然灭了。

时夏禾立刻走出房门，刚到走廊，就撞见祁晏辞从书房出来。

男人穿着黑色衬衣，领口松了两颗扣子，袖口挽到小臂，露出一截冷白腕骨。

他脸色比昨晚更白，眉眼间压着浓重倦意，眼底却还残着未散的冷厉。

像刚从一场高压会议里抽身出来。

明明疲惫得厉害，却依旧冷得让人不敢靠近。

他手里拿着杯子，像是要去接水。

时夏禾立刻上前：“祁先生，我来吧。”

祁晏辞看了她一眼，没拒绝，把杯子递给她。

时夏禾接过来，才发现杯底还残着一点咖啡。

她动作一顿：“您一晚上都在喝咖啡？”

祁晏辞皱眉，显然不喜欢被问。

时夏禾立刻放轻声音：“咖啡提神，但喝多了耗气伤阴，也容易扰动心神。”

她顿了顿，又道：“您脸色不太好，如果熬夜后还靠咖啡硬撑，身体会更吃不消。”

祁晏辞眉眼间的不耐更重。

时夏禾识趣闭嘴，倒掉杯底残液，洗干净杯子，重新接了杯温水递过去。

祁晏辞接过，转身要走。

时夏禾犹豫两秒，还是开口：“祁先生，您要是太累，我可以帮您按按头部穴位，稍微放松一下。”

祁晏辞脚步顿住。

空气安静得有些压人。

就在时夏禾以为他会拒绝时，男人忽然转身，走到沙发前坐下。

水杯被他放在茶几上。

“按按看。”

时夏禾眼睛一亮：“好。”

她先去洗了手，又用温水焐热指尖，这才走到沙发后。

祁晏辞靠着沙发，眼皮半阖，眉心却始终紧皱。

明明已经累到极点，整个人却还是绷着。

像一张拉满太久的弓。

时夏禾放轻动作，指腹先落在他太阳穴附近。

男人身体微不可察地僵了一下。

她立刻低声道：“我轻一点，您要是不舒服，随时说。”

祁晏辞没有开口。

时夏禾这才慢慢按下去。

太阳穴，印堂，百会，风池。

她指法很稳，力道由轻到重，一点点揉开他紧绷的穴位。

一开始，祁晏辞眉心还蹙着，呼吸也浅。

没过多久，那股压在他眉眼间的冷躁便慢慢散了些。

客厅里很安静。

只有窗外隐约的风声。

时夏禾站在他身后，手指沿着穴位缓慢推揉。

Page (1/3)

The next day, Shi Xiahe woke up at five o'clock.

It's still dark.

She opened the curtains and found that the light in the study next door was still on.

She was stunned for a moment.

Qi Yanci didn't sleep all night?

Just as I was thinking this, the light suddenly went out.

Shi Xiahe immediately walked out of the room, and as soon as he reached the corridor, he saw Qi Yanci coming out of the study.

The man was wearing a black shirt, with two buttons loosened at the collar, and the cuffs were rolled up to his forearm, revealing a cold white wrist bone.

His face was paler than last night, and there was heavy tiredness between his brows and eyes, but there was still a lingering coldness in his eyes.

Like you've just emerged from a high-pressure meeting.

He was obviously very tired, but it was still so cold that no one dared to approach him.

He was holding a cup in his hand, as if he was going to get some water.

Shi Xiahe immediately stepped forward: "Mr. Qi, let me do it."

Qi Yanci glanced at her and handed the cup to her without refusing.

Shi Xiahe took it and found that there was still a little coffee left at the bottom of the cup.

She made a move: "Have you been drinking coffee all night?"

Qi Yanci frowned, obviously not liking being asked.

Shi Xiahe immediately lowered his voice: "Coffee is refreshing, but drinking too much consumes energy and damages yin, and it can also easily disturb the mind."

She paused and then said, "You don't look good. If you continue to rely on coffee after staying up late, your body will be even more stressed."

The impatience between Qi Yanci's brows and eyes became even more serious.

Shi Xiahe shut up, poured out the remaining liquid at the bottom of the cup, washed the cup, took another cup of warm water and handed it over.

Qi Yanci took it and turned to leave.

Shi Xiahe hesitated for two seconds before speaking: "Mr. Qi, if you are too tired, I can help you press the acupuncture points on your head to relax a little."

Qi Yanci paused.

The air was oppressively quiet.

Just when Shi Xiahe thought he would refuse, the man suddenly turned around, walked to the sofa and sat down.

He placed the water glass on the coffee table.

"Press and see."

Shi Xiahe's eyes lit up: "Okay."

She washed her hands first and warmed her fingertips with warm water before walking behind the sofa.

Qi Yanci leaned on the sofa, his eyelids half-closed, but his eyebrows were always furrowed.

He was obviously extremely tired, but his whole body was still tense.

Like a bow that has been drawn too long.

Shi Xiahe made a gentle movement and placed his fingertips near his temple first.

The man's body stiffened slightly.

She immediately whispered: "Let me be gentle. If you feel uncomfortable, feel free to tell me."

Qi Yanci did not speak.

Shi Xiahe slowly pressed down.

Temple, Yintang, Baihui, Fengchi.

Her fingering techniques were very steady, from light to heavy, and she gradually opened his tight acupuncture points.

At first, Qi Yanci's eyebrows were still frowning and his breathing was shallow.

It didn't take long for the coldness that pressed between his brows and eyes to slowly dissipate.

The living room was quiet.

There was only the faint sound of wind outside the window.

Shi Xiahe stood behind him, slowly massaging the acupuncture points with his fingers.
